name: config-relative-labels
goal: Show config variable paths without repeating the matching table title; preserve canonical search and source identities.

evidence: Configs repeat each table title in variable links. Display only the matching dotted prefix relative to its table; retain canonical search, inspection and navigation identities.

The standard grouped-catalog browser matrix and measured nonvisual catalog render explicitly expected full prefixes. Strengthen those same tests for nested relative labels, canonical search and retained inspection identities at current and historical revisions.
